title.en: Partners' capital accounts: fixed and fluctuating
title.kn: ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆಗಳು: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಮತ್ತು ಚಲಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನ

heading.en: Where does a partner's salary go?

hook.en: A partner's capital is ₹2 lakh. During the year she earns salary and interest and also withdraws cash. Should her capital account keep changing?
hook.kn: ಪಾಲುದಾರಳ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ₹2 ಲಕ್ಷ. ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ವೇತನ, ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಹಣವನ್ನೂ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವಳ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರಬೇಕೇ?

objectives.en: Distinguish fixed and fluctuating capital methods
Prepare partners' capital and current accounts

narration.en: A partner's capital is ₹2 lakh. During the year she earns salary and interest and also withdraws cash. Should her capital account keep changing? There are two methods: fixed capital and fluctuating capital.
narration.kn: ಪಾಲುದಾರಳ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ₹2 ಲಕ್ಷ. ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ವೇತನ, ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಹಣವನ್ನೂ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವಳ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿರಬೇಕೇ? ಎರಡು ವಿಧಾನಗಳಿವೆ: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಚಲಿಸುವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ.

body.en: Two accounts are kept for each partner. The capital account changes only when capital is permanently added or withdrawn. Every other item — interest on capital, salary, commission, share of profit, drawings and interest on drawings — goes to the partner's current account. The capital account always has a credit balance; the current account may be debit or credit.
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪಾಲುದಾರನಿಗೆ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ವೇತನ, ಲಾಭದ ಪಾಲು, ಸೆಳೆತಗಳು ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಜಮಾ ಶಿಲ್ಕು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Fixed and fluctuating capital

narration.en: Under the fluctuating method everything goes to one capital account. Draw the T-account.

say.en: Under the fluctuating method everything goes to one capital account. Draw the T-account.
On the credit side: opening capital, interest on capital, salary and share of profit.
On the debit side: drawings and interest on drawings. The balance carried down is two lakh fifty-eight thousand five hundred.
Under the fixed method the capital account stays at two lakh. All the other items go to a current account.
The current account closes with a credit balance of fifty-eight thousand five hundred. Together: 2,00,000 + 58,500 = 2,58,500, the same total as before.

body.en: Only one account, the capital account, is kept. All adjustments are posted to it, so its balance changes every year. This is the method followed when the deed does not say otherwise.
body.kn: ಚಲಿಸುವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಗಳು ಅದಕ್ಕೇ ಹೋಗುವುದರಿಂದ ಅದರ ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

blocks.formula: \text{Closing capital} = \text{Opening} + \text{Interest on capital} + \text{Salary} + \text{Share of profit} - \text{Drawings} - \text{Interest on drawings}

caption.en: Change the opening capital, rate of interest on capital, share of profit and drawings. Closing capital = opening + interest + salary (₹24,000) + profit − drawings − interest on drawings (₹1,500).

narration.en: Move the sliders and watch the closing capital. Under the fixed method only the current account would change.

tryThis.en: Check the worked example: 2,00,000, 10%, 46,000 and 30,000 give ₹2,58,500.
Raise drawings until the current account turns negative: that is a debit balance.
Why can the capital account never show a debit balance under the fixed method?

problem.en: Ram's capital on 1 April 2023 is ₹2,00,000. For the year: interest on capital ₹20,000, salary ₹24,000, share of profit ₹46,000, drawings ₹30,000, interest on drawings ₹1,500. Find his closing balances under (a) the fluctuating and (b) the fixed capital method.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Ram's capital on 1 April 2023 is ₹2,00,000. For the year: interest on capital ₹20,000, salary ₹24,000, share of profit ₹46,000, drawings ₹30,000, interest on drawings ₹1,500. Find his closing balances under (a) the fluctuating and (b) the fixed capital method.

body.en: Under the fixed method, ask: is this a permanent change of capital? If not, it belongs to the current account.

narration.en: Fixed means frozen. Under the fixed method, ask: is this a permanent change of capital? If not, it belongs to the current account.

mnemonic.en: Fixed = Frozen capital, Current = Changing items

points.en: Fixed method: capital account plus current account.
points.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ವಿಧಾನ: ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆ.

points.en: Interest, salary, profit share and drawings go to the current account under the fixed method.
points.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ವೇತನ, ಲಾಭ, ಸೆಳೆತಗಳು ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ.

points.en: Fluctuating method: one capital account that changes every year.
points.kn: ಚಲಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನ: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಒಂದೇ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ.

homework.en: Prepare capital accounts of two partners under both methods using your own figures.

narration.en: Recap. Fixed method: capital account plus current account. Interest, salary, profit share and drawings go to the current account under the fixed method. Fluctuating method: one capital account that changes every year.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸ್ಥಿರ ವಿಧಾನ: ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆ. ಸ್ಥಿರ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ವೇತನ, ಲಾಭ, ಸೆಳೆತಗಳು ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ. ಚಲಿಸುವ ವಿಧಾನ: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಒಂದೇ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ.
